      <AssemblyReference>System.Linq</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>UiPath.System.Activities</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365</AssemblyReference>
    </sco:Collection>
  </TextExpression.ReferencesForImplementation>

  <Sequence DisplayName="Main Sequence" sap2010:WorkflowViewState.IdRef="Sequence_1">
    <Sequence.Variables>
      <!-- The email that triggered this run -->
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="umo365:Office365Message" Name="receivedEmail" />
      <!-- Urgency classification outputs -->
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:Int32" Name="urgencyScore" Default="0" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="urgencyTier" Default=""STANDARD"" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="classificationReason" Default="""" />
      <!-- O365 connection ID — replace with your real Integration Service connection GUID -->
      <!-- To find it: uip is connections list uipath-microsoft-outlook365 --all-folders --output json -->
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="connectionId" Default=""00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"" />
      <!-- Escalation team inbox — TODO: replace with your real escalation mailbox/distribution list -->
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="escalationTeamEmail" Default=""support-escalations@yourcompany.com"" />
      <!-- ACK reply body template (HTML) -->
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="ackBodyHtml" Default="""" />
      <!-- Escalation notification body template (HTML) -->
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="escalationBodyHtml" Default="""" />
    </Sequence.Variables>

    <!-- =========================================================
         STEP 1: Trigger — fires on every new Outlook inbox email
         PLACEMENT: MUST be the first activity in the root Sequence.
         This is an Integration trigger — it is registered by Orchestrator
         via the Integration Service webhook. Each new email dispatches
         a fresh job that runs this workflow.

         BEFORE DEPLOYMENT:
           1. Replace ConnectionId with your real O365 connection GUID.
              Run: uip is connections list uipath-microsoft-outlook365 --all-folders --output json
           2. Optionally set FilterExpression to pre-filter server-side
              (e.g. restrict to a specific folder or only unread emails).
         ========================================================= -->
    <umamt:NewEmailReceived
      ConnectionAccountName="{x:Null}"
      ContinueOnError="{x:Null}"
      Filter="{x:Null}"
      JobData="{x:Null}"
      UiPathEvent="{x:Null}"
      UiPathEventConnector="{x:Null}"
      UiPathEventObjectId="{x:Null}"
      UiPathEventObjectType="{x:Null}"
      AuthScopesInvalid="False"
      BrowserFolderId="INBOX"
      BrowserFolderName="Inbox"
      ConnectionId="[connectionId]"
      DisplayName="New Email Received (Trigger)"
      FilterExpression="(parentFolderId=='INBOX')"
      IncludeAttachments="False"
      MarkAsRead="False"
      Result="[receivedEmail]"
      UseConnectionService="True"
      WithAttachmentsOnly="False" />

    <!-- =========================================================
         STEP 2: Main processing wrapped in Try/Catch for resilience
         ========================================================= -->
    <TryCatch DisplayName="Process Email — Error Boundary">
      <TryCatch.Try>
        <Sequence DisplayName="Try">

          <!-- Step 2a: Log receipt -->
          <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" DisplayName="Log: Email received">
            <ui:LogMessage.Message>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"[EmailEscalationBot] New email received. From={receivedEmail.FromAddress} Subject={receivedEmail.Subject} MessageId={receivedEmail.MessageId}"" />
              </InArgument>
            </ui:LogMessage.Message>
          </ui:LogMessage>

          <!-- Step 2b: Classify urgency by invoking helper workflow -->
          <ui:InvokeWorkflowFile
            WorkflowFileName="Workflows\ClassifyUrgency.xaml"
            DisplayName="Classify Email Urgency">
            <ui:InvokeWorkflowFile.Arguments>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="umo365:Office365Message" x:Key="in_Email">[receivedEmail]</InArgument>
              <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Int32" x:Key="out_UrgencyScore">[urgencyScore]</OutArgument>
              <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String" x:Key="out_UrgencyTier">[urgencyTier]</OutArgument>
              <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String" x:Key="out_ClassificationReason">[classificationReason]</OutArgument>
            </ui:InvokeWorkflowFile.Arguments>
          </ui:InvokeWorkflowFile>

          <!-- Step 2c: Mark email as read (prevents duplicate processing on re-runs) -->
          <umam:MarkAsReadUnreadConnections
            ConnectionId="[connectionId]"
            MarkAsReadUnread="Read"
            DisplayName="Mark Email As Read">
            <umam:MarkAsReadUnreadConnections.Email>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="umo365:Office365Message">[receivedEmail]</InArgument>
            </umam:MarkAsReadUnreadConnections.Email>
          </umam:MarkAsReadUnreadConnections>

          <!-- Step 2d: Send auto-acknowledgement reply to sender (ALL tiers) -->
          <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:String" DisplayName="Build ACK reply body">
            <Assign.To>
              <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="ackBodyHtml" />
              </OutArgument>
            </Assign.To>
            <Assign.Value>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText=""<p>Thank you for contacting our support team.</p><p>We have received your message and a member of our team will be in touch with you shortly.</p><p>Your reference number for this enquiry is: <strong>" & receivedEmail.MessageId & "</strong></p><p>If your issue is urgent, please include the word <strong>URGENT</strong> in your subject line or reply to this email.</p><br/><p>Kind regards,<br/>Support Team</p>"" />
              </InArgument>
            </Assign.Value>
          </Assign>

          <umam:ReplyToEmailConnections
            ConnectionId="[connectionId]"
            Body="[ackBodyHtml]"
            ReplyToAll="False"
            SaveAsDraft="False"
            DisplayName="Send Auto-Acknowledgement Reply">
            <umam:ReplyToEmailConnections.Email>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="umo365:Office365Message">[receivedEmail]</InArgument>
            </umam:ReplyToEmailConnections.Email>
            <umam:ReplyToEmailConnections.AttachmentsBackup>
              <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umame:AttachmentInputMode" StoredValue="Builder">
                <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                  <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umame:AttachmentInputMode, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
              </usau:BackupSlot>
            </umam:ReplyToEmailConnections.AttachmentsBackup>
            <umam:ReplyToEmailConnections.MailboxArg>
              <umamm:MailboxArgument UseSharedMailbox="False">
                <umamm:MailboxArgument.Backup>
                  <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umame:MailboxSelectionMode" StoredValue="NoMailbox">
                    <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                      <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umame:MailboxSelectionMode, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                    </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                  </usau:BackupSlot>
                </umamm:MailboxArgument.Backup>
              </umamm:MailboxArgument>
            </umam:ReplyToEmailConnections.MailboxArg>
          </umam:ReplyToEmailConnections>

          <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" DisplayName="Log: ACK reply sent">
            <ui:LogMessage.Message>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"[EmailEscalationBot] ACK reply sent to {receivedEmail.FromAddress}"" />
              </InArgument>
            </ui:LogMessage.Message>
          </ui:LogMessage>

          <!-- Step 2e: Branch on urgency tier -->
          <If DisplayName="Route by Urgency Tier">
            <If.Condition>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean" ExpressionText="urgencyTier = "HIGH"" />
              </InArgument>
            </If.Condition>
            <If.Then>
              <!-- ===================================================
                   HIGH PRIORITY PATH — immediate personal attention
                   =================================================== -->
              <Sequence DisplayName="HIGH Priority — Escalation Path">

                <ui:LogMessage Level="Warn" DisplayName="Log: HIGH priority email detected">
                  <ui:LogMessage.Message>
                    <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                      <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"[EmailEscalationBot] HIGH PRIORITY email detected! Score={urgencyScore} Reason={classificationReason} From={receivedEmail.FromAddress} Subject={receivedEmail.Subject}"" />
                    </InArgument>
                  </ui:LogMessage.Message>
                </ui:LogMessage>

                <!-- Tag email with HIGH-PRIORITY category in Outlook -->
                <umam:SetEmailCategoriesConnections
                  ConnectionId="[connectionId]"
                  CategoriesToRemove="None"
                  CategoriesToAssign="[New String(){"HIGH-PRIORITY"}]"
                  DisplayName="Tag Email: HIGH-PRIORITY Category">
                  <umam:SetEmailCategoriesConnections.Email>
                    <InArgument x:TypeArguments="umo365:Office365Message">[receivedEmail]</InArgument>
                  </umam:SetEmailCategoriesConnections.Email>
                  <umam:SetEmailCategoriesConnections.MailboxArg>
                    <umamm:MailboxArgument UseSharedMailbox="False">
                      <umamm:MailboxArgument.Backup>
                        <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umame:MailboxSelectionMode" StoredValue="NoMailbox">
                          <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                            <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umame:MailboxSelectionMode, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                          </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                        </usau:BackupSlot>
                      </umamm:MailboxArgument.Backup>
                    </umamm:MailboxArgument>
                  </umam:SetEmailCategoriesConnections.MailboxArg>
                </umam:SetEmailCategoriesConnections>

                <!-- Move email to High-Priority folder for visibility -->
                <umam:MoveEmailConnections
                  ConnectionId="[connectionId]"
                  CreateFolderIfMissing="True"
                  DisplayName="Move to: High-Priority Inbox">
                  <umam:MoveEmailConnections.Email>
                    <InArgument x:TypeArguments="umo365:Office365Message">[receivedEmail]</InArgument>
                  </umam:MoveEmailConnections.Email>
                  <umam:MoveEmailConnections.MailFolderArgument>
                    <umamm:MailFolderArgument SelectionMode="EnterPath">
                      <umamm:MailFolderArgument.Backup>
                        <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umame:ItemSelectionMode" StoredValue="EnterPath">
                          <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                            <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umame:ItemSelectionMode, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                          </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                        </usau:BackupSlot>
                      </umamm:MailFolderArgument.Backup>
                      <umamm:MailFolderArgument.ManualEntryFolder>
                        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">["High-Priority Inbox"]</InArgument>
                      </umamm:MailFolderArgument.ManualEntryFolder>
                    </umamm:MailFolderArgument>
                  </umam:MoveEmailConnections.MailFolderArgument>
                  <umam:MoveEmailConnections.MailboxArg>
                    <umamm:MailboxArgument UseSharedMailbox="False">
                      <umamm:MailboxArgument.Backup>
                        <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umame:MailboxSelectionMode" StoredValue="NoMailbox">
                          <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                            <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umame:MailboxSelectionMode, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                          </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                        </usau:BackupSlot>
                      </umamm:MailboxArgument.Backup>
                    </umamm:MailboxArgument>
                  </umam:MoveEmailConnections.MailboxArg>
                </umam:MoveEmailConnections>

                <!-- Build escalation notification body -->
                <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:String" DisplayName="Build escalation notification body">
                  <Assign.To>
                    <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                      <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="escalationBodyHtml" />
                    </OutArgument>
                  </Assign.To>
                  <Assign.Value>
                    <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                      <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText=""<h2 style='color:#c0392b'>⚠ HIGH-PRIORITY Support Email Requires Immediate Attention</h2><table border='1' cellpadding='6'><tr><td><b>From</b></td><td>" & receivedEmail.FromAddress & "</td></tr><tr><td><b>Subject</b></td><td>" & receivedEmail.Subject & "</td></tr><tr><td><b>Urgency Score</b></td><td>" & urgencyScore.ToString() & "</td></tr><tr><td><b>Classification Reason</b></td><td>" & classificationReason & "</td></tr><tr><td><b>Message ID</b></td><td>" & receivedEmail.MessageId & "</td></tr></table><br/><p>This email has been moved to the <strong>High-Priority Inbox</strong> folder and tagged with the <strong>HIGH-PRIORITY</strong> category in Outlook.</p><p>Please action this immediately.</p>"" />
                    </InArgument>
                  </Assign.Value>
                </Assign>

                <!-- Send escalation alert to the support escalation team -->
                <!-- TODO: Replace escalationTeamEmail variable default with your real escalation address -->
                <umam:SendMailConnections
                  ConnectionId="[connectionId]"
                  Body="[escalationBodyHtml]"
                  Importance="High"
                  InputType="HTML"
                  SaveAsDraft="False"
                  To="[New String(){escalationTeamEmail}]"
                  Subject="["[ACTION REQUIRED] HIGH-PRIORITY Support Email: " & receivedEmail.Subject]"
                  DisplayName="Send Escalation Alert to Team">
                  <umam:SendMailConnections.InputTypeBackup>
                    <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umame:BodyInputType" StoredValue="HTML">
                      <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                        <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umame:BodyInputType, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                      </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                    </usau:BackupSlot>
                  </umam:SendMailConnections.InputTypeBackup>
                  <umam:SendMailConnections.AttachmentsBackup>
                    <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umame:AttachmentInputMode" StoredValue="Builder">
                      <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                        <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umame:AttachmentInputMode, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                      </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                    </usau:BackupSlot>
                  </umam:SendMailConnections.AttachmentsBackup>
                  <umam:SendMailConnections.MailboxArg>
                    <umamm:MailboxArgument UseSharedMailbox="False">
                      <umamm:MailboxArgument.Backup>
                        <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umame:MailboxSelectionMode" StoredValue="NoMailbox">
                          <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                            <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umame:MailboxSelectionMode, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                          </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                        </usau:BackupSlot>
                      </umamm:MailboxArgument.Backup>
                    </umamm:MailboxArgument>
                  </umam:SendMailConnections.MailboxArg>
                </umam:SendMailConnections>

                <ui:LogMessage Level="Warn" DisplayName="Log: Escalation alert sent">
                  <ui:LogMessage.Message>
                    <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                      <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"[EmailEscalationBot] Escalation alert sent to {escalationTeamEmail} for email from {receivedEmail.FromAddress}"" />
                    </InArgument>
                  </ui:LogMessage.Message>
                </ui:LogMessage>

              </Sequence>
            </If.Then>
            <If.Else>
              <!-- ===================================================
                   STANDARD / MEDIUM PRIORITY PATH — normal queue
                   MEDIUM gets an extra category tag for visibility
                   =================================================== -->
              <Sequence DisplayName="STANDARD/MEDIUM Priority — Queue Path">

                <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" DisplayName="Log: Standard/Medium priority email">
                  <ui:LogMessage.Message>
                    <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                      <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"[EmailEscalationBot] {urgencyTier} priority email queued for standard processing. Score={urgencyScore} From={receivedEmail.FromAddress}"" />
                    </InArgument>
                  </ui:LogMessage.Message>
                </ui:LogMessage>

                <!-- Tag MEDIUM emails so agents can identify them in the standard queue -->
                <If DisplayName="Tag MEDIUM emails with category">
                  <If.Condition>
                    <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean">
                      <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean" ExpressionText="urgencyTier = "MEDIUM"" />
                    </InArgument>
                  </If.Condition>
                  <If.Then>
                    <Sequence DisplayName="Then">
                      <umam:SetEmailCategoriesConnections
                        ConnectionId="[connectionId]"
                        CategoriesToRemove="None"
                        CategoriesToAssign="[New String(){"MEDIUM-PRIORITY"}]"
                        DisplayName="Tag Email: MEDIUM-PRIORITY Category">
                        <umam:SetEmailCategoriesConnections.Email>
                          <InArgument x:TypeArguments="umo365:Office365Message">[receivedEmail]</InArgument>
                        </umam:SetEmailCategoriesConnections.Email>
                        <umam:SetEmailCategoriesConnections.MailboxArg>
                          <umamm:MailboxArgument UseSharedMailbox="False">
                            <umamm:MailboxArgument.Backup>
                              <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umame:MailboxSelectionMode" StoredValue="NoMailbox">
                                <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                                  <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umame:MailboxSelectionMode, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                                </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                              </usau:BackupSlot>
                            </umamm:MailboxArgument.Backup>
                          </umamm:MailboxArgument>
                        </umam:SetEmailCategoriesConnections.MailboxArg>
                      </umam:SetEmailCategoriesConnections>
                    </Sequence>
                  </If.Then>
                </If>

                <!-- Move standard/medium emails to Standard Queue folder -->
                <umam:MoveEmailConnections
                  ConnectionId="[connectionId]"
                  CreateFolderIfMissing="True"
                  DisplayName="Move to: Standard Support Queue">
                  <umam:MoveEmailConnections.Email>
                    <InArgument x:TypeArguments="umo365:Office365Message">[receivedEmail]</InArgument>
                  </umam:MoveEmailConnections.Email>
                  <umam:MoveEmailConnections.MailFolderArgument>
                    <umamm:MailFolderArgument SelectionMode="EnterPath">
                      <umamm:MailFolderArgument.Backup>
                        <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umame:ItemSelectionMode" StoredValue="EnterPath">
                          <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                            <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umame:ItemSelectionMode, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                          </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                        </usau:BackupSlot>
                      </umamm:MailFolderArgument.Backup>
                      <umamm:MailFolderArgument.ManualEntryFolder>
                        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">["Standard Support Queue"]</InArgument>
                      </umamm:MailFolderArgument.ManualEntryFolder>
                    </umamm:MailFolderArgument>
                  </umam:MoveEmailConnections.MailFolderArgument>
                  <umam:MoveEmailConnections.MailboxArg>
                    <umamm:MailboxArgument UseSharedMailbox="False">
                      <umamm:MailboxArgument.Backup>
                        <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umame:MailboxSelectionMode" StoredValue="NoMailbox">
                          <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                            <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umame:MailboxSelectionMode, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                          </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                        </usau:BackupSlot>
                      </umamm:MailboxArgument.Backup>
                    </umamm:MailboxArgument>
                  </umam:MoveEmailConnections.MailboxArg>
                </umam:MoveEmailConnections>

              </Sequence>
            </If.Else>
          </If>

          <!-- Step 2f: Final log — job complete -->
          <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" DisplayName="Log: Processing complete">
            <ui:LogMessage.Message>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"[EmailEscalationBot] Email processed successfully. Tier={urgencyTier} Score={urgencyScore} MessageId={receivedEmail.MessageId}"" />
              </InArgument>
            </ui:LogMessage.Message>
          </ui:LogMessage>

        </Sequence>
      </TryCatch.Try>

      <TryCatch.Catches>
        <!-- Catch business exceptions — bad data, do not retry -->
        <Catch x:TypeArguments="ui:BusinessRuleException">
          <ActivityAction x:TypeArguments="ui:BusinessRuleException">
            <ActivityAction.Argument>
              <DelegateInArgument x:TypeArguments="ui:BusinessRuleException" Name="bex" />
            </ActivityAction.Argument>
            <Sequence DisplayName="Catch BusinessRuleException">
              <ui:LogMessage Level="Warn" DisplayName="Log: Business rule violation">
                <ui:LogMessage.Message>
                  <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                    <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"[EmailEscalationBot] Business rule violation — skipping email. Error: {bex.Message}"" />
                  </InArgument>
                </ui:LogMessage.Message>
              </ui:LogMessage>
              <!-- Do NOT rethrow — bad data should not fail the job; it's logged and skipped -->
            </Sequence>
          </ActivityAction>
        </Catch>

        <!-- Catch all other (system/transient) exceptions — log and rethrow for GEH -->
        <Catch x:TypeArguments="s:Exception">
          <ActivityAction x:TypeArguments="s:Exception">
            <ActivityAction.Argument>
              <DelegateInArgument x:TypeArguments="s:Exception" Name="ex" />
            </ActivityAction.Argument>
            <Sequence DisplayName="Catch System Exception">
              <ui:LogMessage Level="Error" DisplayName="Log: System exception">
                <ui:LogMessage.Message>
                  <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                    <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"[EmailEscalationBot] System exception processing email from {If(receivedEmail IsNot Nothing, receivedEmail.FromAddress, "<unknown>")}: {ex.ToString()}"" />
                  </InArgument>
                </ui:LogMessage.Message>
              </ui:LogMessage>
              <Rethrow DisplayName="Rethrow to Global Exception Handler" />
            </Sequence>
          </ActivityAction>
        </Catch>
      </TryCatch.Catches>
    </TryCatch>

  </Sequence>
</Activity>

1	# MailFolderArgument
2	
3	> **Agent instruction — read all linked docs before proceeding:** Follow and read every hyperlinked reference document on this page in full before generating XAML. XAML structural patterns (BackupSlots, StoredValue, x:Reference, all-null attributes, namespace declarations) are defined in the linked component, type, and filter docs — not repeated here. If those linked docs also contain hyperlinks to other reference docs, follow those too.
4	
5	**Namespace:** `UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities.Mail.Models`
6	
7	A composition argument object used by Outlook mail activities to specify a mail folder. The `SelectionMode` property determines which sub-properties are required.
8	
9	## InputMode -- SelectionMode (Mail.Enums.ItemSelectionMode)
10	
11	| Mode | Description | Required Properties | AI-XAML Suitable |
12	|------|-------------|--------------------|--------------------|
13	| `Browse` | Select a mail folder via the Studio designer browser widget. | `BrowserFolder`, `BrowserFolderId` | **Not suitable for AI-generated XAML** |
14	| `EnterPath` | Specify a mail folder by name or path. | `ManualEntryFolder` | Yes |
15	
16	## Properties
17	
18	### Core
19	
20	| Property | Type | Description |
21	|----------|------|-------------|
22	| `SelectionMode` | `ItemSelectionMode` | Determines whether to use browser-based folder selection or manual path entry. |
23	| `ConnectionKey` | `String` | The connection identifier from when the folder was originally selected. |
24	| `ConnectionDescriptor` | `String` | A user-friendly label describing the connection. |
25	
26	### EnterPath Mode
27	
28	| Property | Type | Description |
29	|----------|------|-------------|
30	| `ManualEntryFolder` | `InArgument<String>` | The mail folder path (e.g., `Inbox`, `SentItems`, `Drafts`, or a custom folder name). An empty value means the root mail folder (search in all folders). |
31	
32	### Browse Mode (designer-only)
33	
34	| Property | Type | Description |
35	|----------|------|-------------|
36	| `BrowserFolderId` | `String` | The unique identifier of the mail folder selected via the browser. `[AutopilotIgnored]` |
37	| `BrowserFolder` | `InArgument<String>` | The display name of the selected mail folder. |
38	
39	### Other
40	
41	| Property | Type | Description |
42	|----------|------|-------------|
43	| `Backup` | `BackupSlot<ItemSelectionMode>` | Stores the previous SelectionMode for undo. |
44	
45	## XAML Examples
46	
47	> `Backup` is always present in Studio-generated XAML; include it to match Studio's output. `usau:` maps to `xmlns:usau="clr-namespace:UiPath.Shared.Activities.Utils;assembly=UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities"`. `mailenums:` maps to `xmlns:mailenums="clr-namespace:UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities.Mail.Enums;assembly=UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities"`.
48	
49	### EnterPath Mode
50	```xml
51	<mailmodels:MailFolderArgument SelectionMode="EnterPath">
52	    <mailmodels:MailFolderArgument.Backup>
53	        <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="mailenums:ItemSelectionMode" StoredValue="EnterPath">
54	          <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
55	            <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="mailenums:ItemSelectionMode, scg:List(x:Object)" />
56	          </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
57	        </usau:BackupSlot>
58	    </mailmodels:MailFolderArgument.Backup>
59	    <mailmodels:MailFolderArgument.ManualEntryFolder>
60	        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">["Inbox"]</InArgument>
61	    </mailmodels:MailFolderArgument.ManualEntryFolder>
62	</mailmodels:MailFolderArgument>
63	```
64	
65	## Variant: TriggerMailFolderArgument
66	
67	A simplified version used by mail triggers. Properties are stored directly (not as `InArgument<T>`).
68	
69	| Property | Type | Description |
70	|----------|------|-------------|
71	| `FolderId` | `String` | The unique identifier of the selected mail folder (derived from `BrowserFolderId`). |
72	| `FolderName` | `String` | The display name of the selected mail folder. |
73	| `IsBound` | `Boolean` | Whether the folder value is sourced from a data binding. |
74	
75	## Cross-References
76	
77	- Used by Outlook mail activities (GetEmailListConnections, ForEachEmailConnections, MoveEmailConnections, etc.)
78	- Resolves to folders containing [Office365Message](../types/Office365Message.md) items
79	- Related to [O365MailFolder](../types/O365MailFolder.md) type
80	- Emails can be filtered by [MailFilterCollection](../filtering/MailFilterCollection.md)
81	- Shared mailbox access uses [MailboxArgument](MailboxArgument.md)
82

parameters.content:
<Activity mc:Ignorable="sap sap2010" x:Class="Main"
  xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2009/xaml/activities"
  xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
  xmlns:mva="clr-namespace:Microsoft.VisualBasic.Activities;assembly=System.Activities"
  xmlns:s="clr-namespace:System;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib"
  xmlns:sap="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2009/xaml/activities/presentation"
  xmlns:sap2010="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2010/xaml/activities/presentation"
  xmlns:sco="clr-namespace:System.Collections.ObjectModel;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib"
  xmlns:scg="clr-namespace:System.Collections.Generic;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib"
  xmlns:ui="http://schemas.uipath.com/workflow/activities"
  xmlns:umam="clr-namespace:UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities.Mail;assembly=UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities"
  xmlns:umame="clr-namespace:UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities.Mail.Enums;assembly=UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities"
  xmlns:umamm="clr-namespace:UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities.Mail.Models;assembly=UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities"
  xmlns:umamt="clr-namespace:UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities.Mail.Triggers;assembly=UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities"
  xmlns:umo365="clr-namespace:UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Models;assembly=UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365"
  xmlns:usau="clr-namespace:UiPath.Shared.Activities.Utils;assembly=UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities"
  xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
  mva:VisualBasic.Settings="{x:Null}">

  <TextExpression.NamespacesForImplementation>
    <sco:Collection x:TypeArguments="x:String">
      <x:String>System</x:String>
      <x:String>System.Collections.Generic</x:String>
      <x:String>System.Linq</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.Core</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.Core.Activities</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Models</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities.Mail</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities.Mail.Enums</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities.Mail.Models</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities.Mail.Triggers</x:String>
    </sco:Collection>
  </TextExpression.NamespacesForImplementation>
  <TextExpression.ReferencesForImplementation>
    <sco:Collection x:TypeArguments="AssemblyReference">
      <AssemblyReference>System.Activities</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>System.Private.CoreLib</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>System.Linq</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>UiPath.System.Activities</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365</AssemblyReference>
    </sco:Collection>
  </TextExpression.ReferencesForImplementation>

  <Sequence DisplayName="Main Sequence" sap2010:WorkflowViewState.IdRef="Sequence_1">
    <Sequence.Variables>
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="umo365:Office365Message" Name="receivedEmail" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:Int32" Name="urgencyScore" Default="0" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="urgencyTier" Default=""STANDARD"" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="classificationReason" Default="""" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="ackBodyHtml" Default="""" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="escalationBodyHtml" Default="""" />
      <!--
        TODO: Replace this with your real escalation team email address.
        This is the address that receives alert notifications for HIGH-priority emails.
      -->
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="escalationTeamEmail" Default=""support-escalations@yourcompany.com"" />
    </Sequence.Variables>

    <!--
      STEP 1: Integration Trigger - fires on every new email in INBOX.
      PLACEMENT NOTE: This MUST be the first activity in the root Sequence.
      This is an Orchestrator-managed trigger: each new email dispatches a fresh job.

      TODO BEFORE DEPLOYMENT:
        1. Open this file in Studio and set the ConnectionId property to your
           Microsoft 365 Integration Service connection.
           CLI to find connection: uip is connections list uipath-microsoft-outlook365 -all-folders -output json
        2. Adjust FilterExpression if you only want emails from a specific folder.
    -->
    <umamt:NewEmailReceived
      ConnectionAccountName="{x:Null}"
      ContinueOnError="{x:Null}"
      Filter="{x:Null}"
      JobData="{x:Null}"
      UiPathEvent="{x:Null}"
      UiPathEventConnector="{x:Null}"
      UiPathEventObjectId="{x:Null}"
      UiPathEventObjectType="{x:Null}"
      AuthScopesInvalid="False"
      BrowserFolderId="INBOX"
      BrowserFolderName="Inbox"
      ConnectionId="{x:Null}"
      DisplayName="New Email Received (Trigger)"
      FilterExpression="(parentFolderId=='INBOX')"
      IncludeAttachments="False"
      MarkAsRead="False"
      Result="[receivedEmail]"
      UseConnectionService="True"
      WithAttachmentsOnly="False" />

    <!-- STEP 2: Main processing wrapped in Try/Catch for resilience -->
    <TryCatch DisplayName="Process Email - Error Boundary">
      <TryCatch.Try>
        <Sequence DisplayName="Try">

          <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" DisplayName="Log: Email received">
            <ui:LogMessage.Message>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"[EmailEscalationBot] New email received. From={receivedEmail.FromAddress} Subject={receivedEmail.Subject} MessageId={receivedEmail.MessageId}"" />
              </InArgument>
            </ui:LogMessage.Message>
          </ui:LogMessage>

          <!-- Step 2b: Classify urgency -->
          <ui:InvokeWorkflowFile WorkflowFileName="Workflows\ClassifyUrgency.xaml" UnSafe="False" DisplayName="Classify Email Urgency">
            <ui:InvokeWorkflowFile.Arguments>
              <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="x:String, Argument">
                <InArgument x:TypeArguments="umo365:Office365Message" x:Key="in_Email">[receivedEmail]</InArgument>
                <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Int32" x:Key="out_UrgencyScore">[urgencyScore]</OutArgument>
                <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String" x:Key="out_UrgencyTier">[urgencyTier]</OutArgument>
                <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String" x:Key="out_ClassificationReason">[classificationReason]</OutArgument>
              </scg:Dictionary>
            </ui:InvokeWorkflowFile.Arguments>
          </ui:InvokeWorkflowFile>

          <!-- Step 2c: Mark email as read to prevent duplicate processing -->
          <umam:MarkAsReadUnreadConnections
            ConnectionId="{x:Null}"
            MarkAsReadUnread="Read"
            DisplayName="Mark Email As Read">
            <umam:MarkAsReadUnreadConnections.Email>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="umo365:Office365Message">[receivedEmail]</InArgument>
            </umam:MarkAsReadUnreadConnections.Email>
          </umam:MarkAsReadUnreadConnections>

          <!-- Step 2d: Build and send auto-acknowledgement reply (ALL tiers) -->
          <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:String" DisplayName="Build ACK reply body">
            <Assign.To>
              <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="ackBodyHtml" />
              </OutArgument>
            </Assign.To>
            <Assign.Value>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText=""<p>Thank you for contacting our support team.</p><p>We have received your message and a member of our team will be in touch shortly.</p><p>Reference number: <strong>" & receivedEmail.MessageId & "</strong></p><p>If your issue is urgent, please include the word URGENT in your subject line or reply to this email.</p><br/><p>Kind regards,<br/>Support Team</p>"" />
              </InArgument>
            </Assign.Value>
          </Assign>

          <umam:ReplyToEmailConnections
            ConnectionId="{x:Null}"
            Body="[ackBodyHtml]"
            ReplyToAll="False"
            SaveAsDraft="False"
            DisplayName="Send Auto-Acknowledgement Reply">
            <umam:ReplyToEmailConnections.Email>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="umo365:Office365Message">[receivedEmail]</InArgument>
            </umam:ReplyToEmailConnections.Email>
            <umam:ReplyToEmailConnections.AttachmentsBackup>
              <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umame:AttachmentInputMode" StoredValue="Builder">
                <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                  <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umame:AttachmentInputMode, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
              </usau:BackupSlot>
            </umam:ReplyToEmailConnections.AttachmentsBackup>
            <umam:ReplyToEmailConnections.MailboxArg>
              <umamm:MailboxArgument UseSharedMailbox="False">
                <umamm:MailboxArgument.Backup>
                  <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umame:MailboxSelectionMode" StoredValue="NoMailbox">
                    <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                      <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umame:MailboxSelectionMode, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                    </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                  </usau:BackupSlot>
                </umamm:MailboxArgument.Backup>
              </umamm:MailboxArgument>
            </umam:ReplyToEmailConnections.MailboxArg>
          </umam:ReplyToEmailConnections>

          <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" DisplayName="Log: ACK reply sent">
            <ui:LogMessage.Message>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"[EmailEscalationBot] ACK reply sent to {receivedEmail.FromAddress}"" />
              </InArgument>
            </ui:LogMessage.Message>
          </ui:LogMessage>

          <!-- Step 2e: Route by urgency tier -->
          <If DisplayName="Route by Urgency Tier">
            <If.Condition>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean" ExpressionText="urgencyTier = "HIGH"" />
              </InArgument>
            </If.Condition>
            <If.Then>
              <!-- HIGH PRIORITY PATH -->
              <Sequence DisplayName="HIGH Priority - Escalation Path">

                <ui:LogMessage Level="Warn" DisplayName="Log: HIGH priority detected">
                  <ui:LogMessage.Message>
                    <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                      <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText="$"[EmailEscalationBot] HIGH PRIORITY email! Score={urgencyScore} Reason={classificationReason} From={receivedEmail.FromAddress} Subject={receivedEmail.Subject}"" />
                    </InArgument>
                  </ui:LogMessage.Message>
                </ui:LogMessage>

                <!-- Tag with HIGH-PRIORITY category in Outlook -->
                <umam:SetEmailCategoriesConnections
                  ConnectionId="{x:Null}"
                  CategoriesToRemove="None"
                  CategoriesToAssign="[New String(){"HIGH-PRIORITY"}]"
                  DisplayName="Tag: HIGH-PRIORITY Category">
                  <umam:SetEmailCategoriesConnections.Email>
                    <InArgument x:TypeArguments="umo365:Office365Message">[receivedEmail]</InArgument>
                  </umam:SetEmailCategoriesConnections.Email>
                  <umam:SetEmailCategoriesConnections.MailboxArg>
                    <umamm:MailboxArgument UseSharedMailbox="False">
                      <umamm:MailboxArgument.Backup>
                        <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umame:MailboxSelectionMode" StoredValue="NoMailbox">
                          <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                            <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umame:MailboxSelectionMode, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                          </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                        </usau:BackupSlot>
                      </umamm:MailboxArgument.Backup>
                    </umamm:MailboxArgument>
                  </umam:SetEmailCategoriesConnections.MailboxArg>
                </umam:SetEmailCategoriesConnections>

                <!-- Move to High-Priority Inbox folder -->
                <umam:MoveEmailConnections
                  ConnectionId="{x:Null}"
                  CreateFolderIfMissing="True"
                  DisplayName="Move to: High-Priority Inbox">
                  <umam:MoveEmailConnections.Email>
                    <InArgument x:TypeArguments="umo365:Office365Message">[receivedEmail]</InArgument>
                  </umam:MoveEmailConnections.Email>
                  <umam:MoveEmailConnections.MailFolderArgument>
                    <umamm:MailFolderArgument SelectionMode="EnterPath">
                      <umamm:MailFolderArgument.Backup>
                        <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umame:ItemSelectionMode" StoredValue="EnterPath">
                          <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                            <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umame:ItemSelectionMode, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                          </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                        </usau:BackupSlot>
                      </umamm:MailFolderArgument.Backup>
                      <umamm:MailFolderArgument.ManualEntryFolder>
                        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">["High-Priority Inbox"]</InArgument>
                      </umamm:MailFolderArgument.ManualEntryFolder>
                    </umamm:MailFolderArgument>
                  </umam:MoveEmailConnections.MailFolderArgument>
                  <umam:MoveEmailConnections.MailboxArg>
                    <umamm:MailboxArgument UseSharedMailbox="False">
                      <umamm:MailboxArgument.Backup>
                        <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umame:MailboxSelectionMode" StoredValue="NoMailbox">
                          <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                            <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umame:MailboxSelectionMode, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                          </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                        </usau:BackupSlot>
                      </umamm:MailboxArgument.Backup>
                    </umamm:MailboxArgument>
                  </umam:MoveEmailConnections.MailboxArg>
                </umam:MoveEmailConnections>

                <!-- Build escalation notification email body -->
                <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:String" DisplayName="Build escalation alert body">
                  <Assign.To>
                    <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                      <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="escalationBodyHtml" />
                    </OutArgument>
                  </Assign.To>
                  <Assign.Value>
                    <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                      <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText=""<h2 style='color:#c0392b'>HIGH-PRIORITY Support Email - Immediate Attention Required</h2><table border='1' cellpadding='6'><tr><td><b>From</b></td><td>" & receivedEmail.FromAddress & "</td></tr><tr><td><b>Subject</b></td><td>" & receivedEmail.Subject & "</td></tr><tr><td><b>Urgency Score</b></td><td>" & urgencyScore.ToString() & "</td></tr><tr><td><b>Classification Reason</b></td><td>" & classificationReason & "</td></tr><tr><td><b>Message ID</b></td><td>" & receivedEmail.MessageId & "</td></tr></table><br/><p>The email has been moved to the High-Priority Inbox folder and tagged HIGH-PRIORITY in Outlook.</p><p>Please action this immediately.</p>"" />
                    </InArgument>
                  </Assign.Value>
                </Assign>

                <!--
                  Send escalation alert to the support escalation team.
                  TODO: Update escalationTeamEmail variable (set in Sequence.Variables above)
                  to your real team distribution list or shared mailbox.
                -->
                <umam:SendMailConnections
                  ConnectionId="{x:Null}"
                  Body="[escalationBodyHtml]"
                  Importance="High"
                  InputType="HTML"
                  SaveAsDraft="False"
                  To="[New String(){escalationTeamEmail}]"
                  Subject="["[ACTION REQUIRED] HIGH-PRIORITY Support Email: " & receivedEmail.Subject]"
                  DisplayName="Send Escalation Alert to Team">
                  <umam:SendMailConnections.InputTypeBackup>
                    <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umame:BodyInputType" StoredValue="HTML">
                      <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                        <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umame:BodyInputType, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                      </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                    </usau:BackupSlot>
                  </umam:SendMailConnections.InputTypeBackup>
                  <umam:SendMailConnections.AttachmentsBackup>
                    <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umame:AttachmentInputMode" StoredValue="Builder">
                      <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                        <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umame:AttachmentInputMode, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                      </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                    </usau:BackupSlot>
                  </umam:SendMailConnections.AttachmentsBackup>
                  <umam:SendMailConnections.MailboxArg>
                    <umamm:MailboxArgument UseSharedMailbox="False">
                      <umamm:MailboxArgument.Backup>

1	# Trigger Pattern Guide
2	
3	Authoring and editing trigger workflows in XAML. Covers placement, lifecycle, `ui:TriggerScope` handling, and verification.
4	
5	## Two Trigger Types
6	
7	`uip rpa activities find` returns `isTrigger` and `triggerType` on every trigger activity. `triggerType` is the type discriminator.
8	
9	### Integration triggers (`triggerType: "integration"`) — strict placement
10	
11	- **MUST be the first activity** of `Main.xaml`'s root `Sequence`.
12	- **CANNOT be placed inside `ui:TriggerScope`.**
13	- **Connection asset:** required for IS-based triggers (Mail, GSuite, O365, Salesforce, Jira, Slack, ServiceNow, any `*.IntegrationService.Activities` package). Not required for Orchestrator-native triggers (`TimeTrigger`, `QueueTrigger`, `ManualTrigger`).
14	- **Runtime behavior:** the activity is an **unwrap routine**. Orchestrator (or the IS webhook layer) holds the subscription, dispatches a fresh job per event, and injects event payload context. The activity's `Execute` reads that context — e.g., `NewEmailReceived.ExecuteWithRetryAsync` reads `UiPathEventObjectId`, then calls `GraphServiceClient.GetEmailByIdAsync(...)` to fetch the email. It does not poll, watch, or listen.
15	- **Examples:** `NewEmailReceived` (O365 Outlook, GSuite Gmail), `NewFileCreated`, `NewEventCreated`, `NewEventInvitationReceived`, `RowAddedToSheetBottom`, SharePoint list-item triggers, every IS connector trigger (Salesforce / Jira / Slack / ServiceNow / Microsoft Teams CRUD events), `TimeTrigger`, `QueueTrigger`, `ManualTrigger`.
16	
17	### Local triggers (`triggerType: "local"`) — flexible placement
18	
19	- Place EITHER:
20	  - As the first activity of `Main.xaml`'s root `Sequence` → Orchestrator dispatches a fresh job per event (entry-point semantics).
21	  - Inside `<ui:TriggerScope.Triggers>`, handler in `<ui:TriggerScope.Action>` → the robot stays alive while the scope is active; the trigger fires in-process.
22	- The placement choice is a runtime-model decision (per-event jobs vs long-running robot). Both are valid.
23	- **Connection asset:** not required.
24	- **Runtime behavior:** the activity is a real in-process subscriber. `StartMonitor` installs the listener (e.g. `FileChangeTriggerV3` → `FileSystemWatcher` + a background event-loop `Task` in `UiPath.Core.Activities.FileWatcher`); events flow through `TriggerScope`'s bookmark queue when wrapped, or through entry-point dispatch when placed at root.
25	- **Examples:** `FileChangeTriggerV3`, `RepeatTrigger`, `GlobalVariableChangedTrigger`, UIA Next triggers (`NClickTrigger`, `NKeyboardTrigger`), classic UIA V2 triggers (`ClickTriggerV2`, `ClickImageTriggerV2`, `KeyPressTriggerV2`, `ElementStateChangeTrigger`, `ElementAttributeChangeTrigger`, `MouseTriggerV2`, `HotkeyTriggerV2`, `SystemTriggerV2`, `SapSessionTrigger`), `AppRequestTrigger`.
26	
27	Integration triggers never go inside `ui:TriggerScope`. Local triggers have no equivalent restriction — both placements are valid.
28	
29	## Decision Rule
30	
31	1. Run `uip rpa activities find --query "<event keyword>" --output json`. Read `isTrigger` and `triggerType`.
32	2. Branch on the CLI signal:
33	   - **Both fields absent** → regular activity, not a trigger.
34	   - **`isTrigger: true`, `triggerType: "integration"`** → integration trigger. **Place as the first activity of root `Sequence`; never inside `ui:TriggerScope`.** Check connection requirement — IS-based packages (Mail/GSuite/O365/`*.IntegrationService.Activities`) need a `ConnectionId`; `TimeTrigger`/`QueueTrigger`/`ManualTrigger` do not.
35	   - **`isTrigger: true`, `triggerType: "local"`** → local trigger. **Choose placement** based on runtime model — first activity of root for per-event dispatch, inside `<ui:TriggerScope.Triggers>` for long-running in-process subscription. No connection asset.
36	   - **`isTrigger: true`, unknown `triggerType`** → unknown category (forward-compat — new flavors may appear). Read the bundled doc and ask the user if still ambiguous.
37	3. For trigger activities, read **both** docs (per SKILL.md Rule 21): the bundled `references/activity-docs/<packageName>/<closest-version>/activities/<ClassNameTail>.md` **and** the project-local `{PROJECT_DIR}/.local/docs/packages/<packageName>/activities/<ClassNameTail>.md` if present. The bundled doc carries placement guidance, deployment context, and cross-cutting namespace/assembly gotchas the auto-generated `.local/docs` extractor omits; the `.local/docs` version reflects the exact installed package version. Also read the package's bundled `overview.md`.
38	
39	## Entry-Point Worked Example — Office 365 New Email Received
40	
41	A workflow that fires when an Outlook email arrives in INBOX with attachments.
42	
43	```xml
44	<Activity mc:Ignorable="sap sap2010" x:Class="Main"
45	    xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2009/xaml/activities"
46	    xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
47	    xmlns:sap="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2009/xaml/activities/presentation"
48	    xmlns:sap2010="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2010/xaml/activities/presentation"
49	    xmlns:sco="clr-namespace:System.Collections.ObjectModel;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib"
50	    xmlns:ui="http://schemas.uipath.com/workflow/activities"
51	    xmlns:umamt="clr-namespace:UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities.Mail.Triggers;assembly=UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities"
52	    xmlns:umm="clr-namespace:UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Models;assembly=UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365"
53	    xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml">
54	  <Sequence DisplayName="Main Sequence">
55	    <Sequence.Variables>
56	      <Variable x:TypeArguments="umm:Office365Message" Name="email" />
57	    </Sequence.Variables>
58	
59	    <umamt:NewEmailReceived
60	        DisplayName="New Email Received"
61	        ConnectionId="<CONNECTION_GUID>"
62	        UseConnectionService="True"
63	        AuthScopesInvalid="False"
64	        BrowserFolderId="INBOX"
65	        BrowserFolderName="Inbox"
66	        FilterExpression="(parentFolderId=='INBOX')&&(hasAttachments==`true`)"
67	        IncludeAttachments="True"
68	        MarkAsRead="True"
69	        WithAttachmentsOnly="True"
70	        Result="[email]" />
71	
72	    <!-- Handler: rest of the Sequence acts on `email` -->
73	    <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" Message="["Got email from " + email.From.Address]" />
74	  </Sequence>
75	</Activity>
76	```
77	
78	Three critical shape rules:
79	
80	1. The trigger is the **first child** of the root `Sequence`. There is no `ui:TriggerScope` wrapping it.
81	2. `Result="[email]"` binds the activity's `Office365Message` output to a workflow-scope variable. The rest of the `Sequence` is the handler.
82	3. `FilterExpression` runs **server-side** (free) before the trigger fires — never re-implement the filter as an `If` inside the handler. Boolean literals use backticks; AND uses XML-escaped `&&`. Full syntax: [activity-docs/UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities/3.8/activities/NewEmailReceived.md](activity-docs/UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities/3.8/activities/NewEmailReceived.md).
83	
84	## Local Trigger Worked Example — UI Click
85	
86	A workflow that runs while a desktop app is open and reacts to clicks. The exact `xmlns` prefix and args type vary by package — always start from `uip rpa activities get-default-xaml --activity-class-name <FullClassName>` rather than hand-writing the namespace.
87	
88	Structural shape (placeholders in angle brackets — fill from `get-default-xaml`):
89	
90	```xml
91	<Activity x:Class="Main" ...>
92	  <Sequence DisplayName="Main Sequence">
93	    <ui:TriggerScope DisplayName="Trigger Scope"
94	                     SchedulingMode="Sequential"
95	                     xmlns:ui="http://schemas.uipath.com/workflow/activities">
96	      <ui:TriggerScope.Triggers>
97	        <!-- One or more local trigger activities. Get full XAML via:
98	               uip rpa activities get-default-xaml \
99	                 --activity-class-name <FullClassName> \
100	                 --project-dir "<PROJECT_DIR>" --output json -->
101	        <<TriggerPrefix>:<TriggerClassName> DisplayName="..." ... />
102	      </ui:TriggerScope.Triggers>
103	      <ui:TriggerScope.Action>
104	        <ActivityAction x:TypeArguments="<TriggerArgsType>">
105	          <Sequence>
106	            <!-- handler -->
107	          </Sequence>
108	        </ActivityAction>
109	      </ui:TriggerScope.Action>
110	    </ui:TriggerScope>
111	  </Sequence>
112	</Activity>
113	```
114	
115	Shape rules:
116	
117	1. `ui:TriggerScope` (`UiPath.Core.Activities.TriggerScope`, in package `UiPath.System.Activities`) is the container. `Triggers` is a collection — one or more child trigger activities.
118	2. `ui:TriggerScope.Action` is the handler. It is an `ActivityAction` typed on the trigger's args type (e.g. `MonitorClickEventArgs` for `NClickTrigger`, `FileSystemArgs` for file-change variants). Use `get-default-xaml` on the trigger to discover the exact args type.
119	3. **`SchedulingMode`** controls handler queueing (source: `Triggers/TriggerScope.cs`):
120	   - `Concurrent` — fire all handler instances in parallel.
121	   - `Sequential` *(default in most templates)* — queue events; run one handler at a time in arrival order. Filterable triggers can drop duplicate queued events.
122	   - `SequentialCollapse` — sequential, but collapse repeated events to the latest.
123	   - `SequentialDrop` — sequential, but cancel the running handler when a new event arrives.
124	   - `OneTime` — fire once and cancel the scope's child triggers.
125	4. **`ContinueOnError`** — when `true`, a faulted handler logs and the scope keeps running. When `false` (default), a fault stops the scope.
126	5. **`Break`** activity (from `UiPath.System.Activities`) inside the handler exits the `TriggerScope` cleanly.
127	6. The job remains alive for as long as `TriggerScope` is active. This is the wrong choice for events that arrive over hours/days; place the trigger at the workflow root instead, so Orchestrator owns the subscription and dispatches per event.
128	
129	## Reading and Editing Existing TriggerScope XAML
130	
131	Existing projects routinely use `ui:TriggerScope`. When you encounter one, treat it as a valid local-trigger pattern — do not flatten it. The choice between scoped and root placement for a local trigger is a runtime-model decision (long-running robot vs per-event jobs); changing it without the user's intent is wrong.
132	
133	**How to identify:** any XAML containing `<ui:TriggerScope ...>` is a local-trigger workflow. The robot is expected to stay alive while this scope is active.
134	
135	**Safe edits:**
136	
137	- Adding another local trigger to the same scope → append to `<ui:TriggerScope.Triggers>`. Confirm the new trigger's args type matches (or the scope's `Action` `x:TypeArguments` is the common base — typically `TriggerArgs`). Integration triggers cannot be added here.
138	- Modifying the handler → edit inside `<ui:TriggerScope.Action>`. Do not move handler activities outside the scope.
139	- Changing `SchedulingMode` → safe; pick from the values above. Default unset value behaves as `Sequential`.
140	
141	**Unsafe edits — these break the workflow:**
142	
143	- Moving a local trigger out of `ui:TriggerScope` to root placement when the user only asked you to "modernize" the workflow. The two placements have different deployment models (per-event jobs vs long-running robot); ask the user first.
144	- Removing `<ui:TriggerScope.Triggers>` while keeping `<ui:TriggerScope.Action>` — `CacheMetadata` validation fails (`TriggerScope_NoTrigger`).
145	- Inserting an integration trigger (`triggerType: "integration"`) inside `<ui:TriggerScope.Triggers>` — see [Anti-patterns](#anti-patterns).
146	
147	**When to question a TriggerScope you find:** if `<ui:TriggerScope.Triggers>` contains an activity whose bundled doc labels it **Integration trigger** (e.g. `NewEmailReceived`, `TimeTrigger`, `QueueTrigger`), the prior author placed an integration trigger inside a `TriggerScope`. The workflow compiles but does not get registered as an Orchestrator trigger. Flag this to the user — the fix is to move that trigger to the workflow root.
148	
149	## Catalog of Trigger Activities
150	
151	### Integration (root placement, never inside `ui:TriggerScope`)
152	
153	Every activity whose bundled doc labels it **Integration trigger**, plus every Integration Service connector trigger (its `namespace` will contain `.Triggers`). The bundled hand-written docs cover these:
154	
155	| Package | Activity | Bundled doc |
156	|---|---|---|
157	| `UiPath.System.Activities` | `TimeTrigger` (Time Trigger) | [activity-docs/UiPath.System.Activities/26.4/activities/TimeTrigger.md](activity-docs/UiPath.System.Activities/26.4/activities/TimeTrigger.md) |
158	| `UiPath.System.Activities` | `QueueTrigger` (New Item Added to Queue) | [activity-docs/UiPath.System.Activities/26.4/activities/QueueTrigger.md](activity-docs/UiPath.System.Activities/26.4/activities/QueueTrigger.md) |
159	| `UiPath.System.Activities` | `ManualTrigger` (Manual Trigger) | [activity-docs/UiPath.System.Activities/26.4/activities/RuntimeContext.md](activity-docs/UiPath.System.Activities/26.4/activities/RuntimeContext.md) |
160	| `UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities` | `NewEmailReceived` | [activity-docs/UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities/3.8/activities/NewEmailReceived.md](activity-docs/UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities/3.8/activities/NewEmailReceived.md) |
161	| `UiPath.GSuite.Activities` | `NewEmailReceived` (Gmail), `NewFileCreated`, `NewEventCreated`, `NewEventInvitationReceived`, `RowAddedToSheetBottom` | `activity-docs/UiPath.GSuite.Activities/3.8/activities/` |
162	
163	Beyond the bundled set: every Integration Service connector trigger qualifies — Salesforce CREATED/UPDATED/DELETED, Jira issue triggers, ServiceNow record triggers, Slack message triggers, Microsoft Teams triggers, SharePoint list-item triggers, etc. For IS trigger semantics (`eventMode`, webhook URL retrieval, filter trees), query the CLI: `uip is activities list "<connector-key>" --triggers --output json` and `uip is triggers describe "<connector-key>" "<OPERATION>" "<object>" --output json`.
164	
165	### Local (flexible placement — first activity of root, or wrapped in `<ui:TriggerScope.Triggers>`)
166	
167	Concrete authorable activities. Listed by package. For full property surface, run `uip rpa activities get-default-xaml --activity-class-name <FullClassName>` — namespaces and args types vary.
168	
169	| Package | Concrete activities | Notes |
170	|---|---|---|
171	| `UiPath.System.Activities` | `RepeatTrigger`, `GlobalVariableChangedTrigger`, `FileChangeTriggerV3` | Interval, global-variable change, filesystem watcher. |
172	| `UiPath.UIAutomationNext.Activities` | `NClickTrigger`, `NKeyboardTrigger` | UIA Next click and keyboard events. Args types: `MonitorClickEventArgs`, `MonitorKeyboardEventArgs`. Both derive from UIA Next's `TriggerBase<T>` → `Platform.InterruptibleTriggerBase<T>`. |
173	| `UiPath.UIAutomation.Activities` (Classic V2) | Selector-bound: `ClickTriggerV2`, `ClickImageTriggerV2`, `KeyPressTriggerV2`, `ElementStateChangeTrigger`, `ElementAttributeChangeTrigger`. System-level: `MouseTriggerV2`, `HotkeyTriggerV2`, `SystemTriggerV2`, `SapSessionTrigger`. | All share `EventInfoTriggerArgs`. Selector-bound triggers require a target descriptor; system-level triggers monitor process-wide events. `SelectorTriggerActivityV2` and `MouseAndKeyTriggerActivityBase` are abstract bases — not directly authorable. |
174	| `UiPath.WorkflowEvents.Activities` | `AppRequestTrigger` | Cross-workflow request bus inside a running job. |
175	
176	If the activity is not in this table: run `uip rpa activities find --query Trigger` against the installed package and read `triggerType`. `"local"` activities can be placed at root or wrapped in `TriggerScope` — choose per runtime model.
177	
178	## Connection Handling (IS Triggers)
179	
180	Integration triggers from Integration Service packages require a `ConnectionId`. A placeholder GUID (`00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000`) passes `uip rpa validate` and `uip rpa build` but fails at runtime when Orchestrator tries to subscribe. Resolve a real connection scoped to the connector and across all folders (active-folder-only scans miss connections owned by other folders):
181	
182	```bash
183	uip is connections list "<connector-key>" --all-folders --output json
184	```
185	
186	For example, `uip is connections list "uipath-microsoft-outlook365" --all-folders --output json` for the O365 Mail triggers. Copy the connection's GUID into `ConnectionId`. If no connection exists, create one (`uip is connections create <connector-key>`) and verify it's active (`uip is connections ping <connection-id>`).
187	
188	## Server-Side Filtering
189	
190	Integration triggers from IS packages typically expose a filter property — an OData-style boolean predicate (or structured tree) that runs on the connector side **before** the trigger fires. Use it for any "fire only if X" logic. Re-implementing the filter inside the handler wastes Orchestrator dispatch and robot time on events you would discard.
191	
192	Per-package conventions (read each package's bundled `overview.md` for canonical syntax):
193	
194	- **O365 Mail** (`umm:` prefix family): `FilterExpression` as a string attribute. OData-like: `(parentFolderId=='INBOX')`, `(hasAttachments==`true`)`. AND uses `&&`; booleans use backticks. See [activity-docs/UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities/3.8/activities/overview.md](activity-docs/UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities/3.8/activities/overview.md).
195	- **GSuite Gmail**: `Filter` as a structured child element with `LogicalOperator` + `Criteria` leaves, not a string. See [activity-docs/UiPath.GSuite.Activities/3.8/activities/NewEmailReceived.md](activity-docs/UiPath.GSuite.Activities/3.8/activities/NewEmailReceived.md).
196	- **IS connector triggers** (Salesforce, Jira, Slack, …): authored as a structured filter tree, not a string. Discover the filterable field names via `uip is triggers describe "<connector>" "<OPERATION>" "<object>" --output json` → read `Data.FilterFields[*].Name`. The CLI compiles the tree into the runtime expression; do not pass the compiled form directly.
197	
198	## Lifecycle and Verification
199	
200	Lifecycle depends on placement, not type. Two paths:
201	
202	### Entry-point lifecycle (trigger at workflow root)
203	
204	Applies to all integration triggers, and to local triggers placed at root.
205	
206	1. **Author** — place trigger as the first activity of root `Sequence`, bind output to variable, write handler. Per-file `validate` clean.
207	2. **Build** — `uip rpa build "<PROJECT_DIR>" --output json` clean.
208	3. **Publish** — `.nupkg` to Orchestrator (see [publishing-guide.md](publishing-guide.md)). On publish, Orchestrator detects the trigger from the workflow's activity registration and exposes it as a Process/Time/Queue Trigger candidate.
209	
210	**`uip rpa run` is NOT a meaningful smoke test for entry-point triggers.** The CLI executes the workflow once in-process, which does not exercise Orchestrator subscription or the connector's webhook/polling lifecycle. A clean `run` only proves the handler XAML compiles and the trigger activity can be instantiated.
211	
212	### In-process lifecycle (local trigger inside `ui:TriggerScope`)
213	
214	Applies only to local triggers wrapped in `ui:TriggerScope`.
215	
216	1. **Author** — `ui:TriggerScope` with `Triggers` (one or more local trigger activities) and `Action` (the handler). Per-file `validate` clean.
217	2. **Build** — `uip rpa build` clean.
218	3. **Run** — `uip rpa run --file-path Main.xaml --project-dir "<PROJECT_DIR>" --output json`. The robot stays alive; trigger events fire while the run is active. Generate an event (click, file change, etc.) and confirm the handler executes.
219	4. **Deploy** — publish to Orchestrator and start as a long-running attended/unattended job. The job remains active and consumes a robot slot for the duration.
220	
221	## Anti-patterns
222	
223	1. **Integration trigger wrapped in `ui:TriggerScope`.** Re-author by removing the `ui:TriggerScope` wrapper and placing the trigger at the root.
224	2. **Re-implementing the filter as an `If` in the handler.** Robot pays dispatch cost on every event the filter would have rejected. Move the predicate into the trigger's filter property.
225	3. **Calling `uip rpa run` to "test" an O365/Gmail/Salesforce/queue/schedule trigger.** See entry-point lifecycle above — `run` does not exercise Orchestrator subscription.
226	4. **Moving a local trigger out of `ui:TriggerScope` to root placement without intent.** Both placements are valid for local triggers; the choice is a runtime-model decision (per-event jobs vs long-running robot). Confirm with the user before changing it.
227	5. **Hand-editing the auto-generated `.local/docs/.../<Trigger>.md`.** That file is regenerated on package restore. Treat it as read-only; the bundled doc in `references/activity-docs/` is the editable source of placement and example guidance.
228	6. **Inventing an `xmlns:` prefix for an unfamiliar trigger.** Always pull the namespace from `uip rpa activities get-default-xaml --activity-class-name <FullClassName>`; do not infer it from the class's logical hierarchy.
229

1	# UiPath Project Structure
2	
3	## Directory Layout
4	
5	```
6	MyProject/
7	├── project.json          # Project manifest (name, dependencies, settings)
8	├── Main.xaml             # Default entry point (XAML mode) ─┐ typically one
9	├── Main.cs               # Default entry point (coded mode) ─┘ or the other
10	├── *.xaml                # Additional XAML workflow files
11	├── *.cs                  # Coded workflows, test cases, and source files
12	├── *.cs.json             # Auto-generated by Studio — do not create manually
13	├── .codedworkflows/      # Auto-generated coded workflow support files (ConnectionsFactory.cs, ConnectionsManager.cs, ISConnections.cs, etc.)
14	├── .entities/            # Data Fabric entity manifest — EntitiesStore.json. Committed; source of truth for which entities are bound to the project. Managed via uip rpa data-fabric-entities install.
15	├── .local/               # Local cache (package restore, compiled artifacts)
16	│   ├── install/          # Restored NuGet packages
17	│   ├── docs/             # Auto-generated activity documentation
18	│   │   └── packages/     # Per-package doc folders
19	│   ├── .codedworkflows/  # Auto-generated (ObjectRepository.cs, CodedWorkflow.cs, WorkflowRunnerService.cs)
20	│   └── .entities/        # Compiled Data Fabric entity assemblies (DataService.<Namespace>.dll) per install signature. Regenerated on demand — do not edit.
21	├── .objects/             # Object Repository metadata (UI element selectors)
22	├── .project/             # Project metadata
23	│   ├── JitCustomTypesSchema.json  # JIT-compiled custom type definitions
24	│   └── PackageBindingsMetadata.json
25	├── .screenshots/         # Activity screenshots (auto-generated)
26	├── .settings/            # Project-level settings
27	├── .autopilot/           # Autopilot service specific files
28	│   └── skills/           # Project-specific Autopilot skills
29	└── .storage/             # Activity resource storage (bucket-organized)
30	    ├── .design/          # Design-time only resources (NOT packed into published package)
31	    │   └── <bucket>/     # Named bucket to prevent conflicts
32	    └── .runtime/         # Runtime resources (packed into published NuPkg)
33	        └── <bucket>/     # Named bucket with resource files
34	```
35	
36	### Coded-Only Elements
37	
38	- `.cs` files with `[Workflow]`/`[TestCase]` attributes — executable coded automations
39	- `.cs.json` metadata files — auto-generated by Studio for each coded workflow/test case (do not create manually)
40	- `.codedworkflows/` — auto-generated support files (only when project has `.cs` files)
41	- `.local/.codedworkflows/` — auto-generated `ObjectRepository.cs`, `CodedWorkflow.cs`, etc.
42	- `.variations/` — data-driven test parameters (Tests projects only)

44	### XAML-Only Elements
45	
46	- `.xaml` workflow files — visual workflow definitions
47	- Expression language configured in `project.json` (`VisualBasic` or `CSharp`)

54	  "description": "",

92	| Field | Description |
93	|-------|-------------|

commands.result_summary:
# NewEmailReceived — Trigger on Incoming Email

**Integration trigger** (`isTrigger: true, triggerType: "integration"` from `uip rpa activities find`; requires a `ConnectionId` to an O365 Outlook connection). **Placement: strict** — first activity of `Main.xaml`'s root `Sequence`, never inside `ui:TriggerScope`. Orchestrator + Integration Service subscribe externally and dispatch a fresh job per email. See [trigger-pattern-guide.md](../../../../trigger-pattern-guide.md).

Trigger activity (`umamt:` prefix). Null attributes: `ConnectionAccountName`, `ContinueOnError`, `Filter`, `JobData`, `UiPathEvent`, `UiPathEventConnector`, `UiPathEventObjectId`, `UiPathEventObjectType`

```xml
<umamt:NewEmailReceived
    ConnectionAccountName="{x:Null}"
    ContinueOnError="{x:Null}"
    Filter="{x:Null}"
    JobData="{x:Null}"
    UiPathEvent="{x:Null}"
    UiPathEventConnector="{x:Null}"
    UiPathEventObjectId="{x:Null}"
    UiPathEventObjectType="{x:Null}"
    AuthScopesInvalid="False"
    BrowserFolderId="INBOX"
    BrowserFolderName="Inbox"
    ConnectionId="00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
    DisplayName="New Email Received"
    FilterExpression="(parentFolderId=='INBOX')&&(hasAttachments==`true`)"
    IncludeAttachments="True"
    MarkAsRead="True"
    Result="[email]"
    UseConnectionService="True"
    WithAttachmentsOnly="True" />
```

- `BrowserFolderId`: `"INBOX"` (all-caps) — not `"Inbox"`
- `FilterExpression`: OData-style; `&&` is XML-escaped `&&`; booleans use backticks
- `Result`: `umm:Office365Message`

## FilterExpression Examples

| Filter | Expression |
|--------|-----------|
| Inbox only | `(parentFolderId=='INBOX')` |
| Has attachments | `(hasAttachments==\`true\`)` |
| Inbox + attachments | `(parentFolderId=='INBOX')&&(hasAttachments==\`true\`)` |
| Unread only | `(isRead==\`false\`)` |
